name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the European Union's budget for 2026. It rejects the Council's proposed cuts of about 1.3 billion euros and asks to restore or increase money for research, transport and energy links, small businesses, students on Erasmus+, farmers, fisheries, border management, defence, humanitarian aid and health. It also wants the cost of repaying joint European Union borrowing kept separate and transparent, and more staff and money for several European Union agencies and institutions.

- Parliament adds money to many European Union programmes and reverses the Council's cuts.
- It affects students, farmers, fishers, researchers, border regions, crisis-hit countries and agencies.
- Talks with the Council start on 28 October and must end by 17 November 2025.
